SYSTEMATIC BASELINE BUG worth fixing upstream: PANW and CXM both show history.n=0 with the basis string 'all N prior prints on this CIK were filed under a former name before <date>', with cutoff dates of 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-19 respectively. Neither company changed its name. Two independent registrants producing the same artefact two weeks apart is a bug in the former-name filter, not two records events. FPI 6-K TEXT-MATCHING FAILURE confirmed on both foreign private issuers, exactly the mode the stage was built to catch: GASS's history counts its own 2026-08-28 scheduling press release as an earnings print (which is what produced the false 'suspect' verdict), and YSG's history contains a literal duplicate row plus a non-earnings 6-K five days before a real print. Neither history should be used as an earnings base rate.

GASS's event_plausibility='suspect' was a FALSE POSITIVE, not a phantom. The company confirmed the 2026-09-02 print in the same document the cadence checker mistook for a print. This is the mirror image of the failure this stage exists to prevent and is worth recording: a suspect verdict is a prompt to check, not a conclusion.
